text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] SLO: realtime.p99 > 5s over 5m window — firing. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rt-latency

hazel: I'm on pager, checking dashboards :mag:

marta: seeing same on realtime-prod. p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~6.1s, streaming tail increasing, a bunch of `streaming.latency_tail` spikes

sam: any deploys or config changes in last 30m?

hazel: small autoscaler config tweak ~12m ago (reduced max-burst). Rolling back if needed.

devops_jun: running quick infra check -> `kubectl get pods -l service=runtime -o wide` shows one pod restarted 3x in last 10m, others healthy

hazel: logs show a spike in kv cache evictions and `cache_miss` on long sessions. `kvcache.evictions` up 5x

marta: also seeing `batch_queue_length` jump and sustained batch wait times -> impacts tail latency for short requests

hazel: quick mitigations: 1) route-by-policy shift away from eu-region, 2) enable burst capacity, 3) rollback autoscaler tweak if needed

sam: executing route shift now: `infra/rollouts set-routing --service realtime --weight europe=10 --us-east=90` (ran) :white_check_mark:

product-support: any confirmed customer impact? Support tickets?

hazel: a handful of enterprise sessions reported slow responses. CS notified. No widespread 5xxs, just timeouts/slow replies for some streaming sessions

devops_jun: scaling up runtime pool by +2 nodes (triggered `terraform apply`), monitoring node join events

marta: watching p99 — starting a 1m window watch.

incident-bot: Reminder: if p99 > 5s persists for 10m, escalate to eng-sre paging policy.

hazel: after routing shift + scale, p99 dropped to ~3.2s (improving) but still above SLO. Streaming stalls reduce but tail still noisy

sam: plan: keep routing shift, revert autoscaler max-burst change, and increase kv cache TTL for active sessions. Will collect traces for top slow RPCs (`/v1/stream` and `/v1/generate`)

marta: creating postmortem stub and adding initial metrics + links to logs (will link traces once Sam uploads)

hazel: handing off live mitigation and deep triage to eng-sre. @sam please take over and update every 15m until stable

sam: taking it. collecting spans, enabling deep trace sampling for streaming router, will post updates. ETA 15m. :clock15:
